description: Today, Michael Whatley formally accepted the unanimous endorsement of the North Carolina Police Benevolent Association (PBA) during a press conference in Raleigh. Whatley was joined by North Carolina PBA President David Rose and local law enforcement to announce the endorsement and discuss the importance of supporting the men and women who put their lives on the line to keep North Carolina communities safe.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Whatley for Senate
title: Michael Whatley Receives Unanimous Endorsement from North Carolina Police Benevolent Association – Michael Whatley for Senate
